evals.fixture: fixtures/six-two-sticky/round.md, pasted in full after the prompt
evals.expected_output: A note in the fixed shape: a heading line; items 2 and 5 as the sticky items, each with a kind and a one-line why; one Trivial line naming 1, 3, 4 and 6; then an indented to reverse / cheaper now pair for each of 2 and 5.
